key_patterns.pattern: Member with high RAF score and multiple open coding gaps
key_patterns.meaning: Documented complexity is not fully captured in claims, understating true risk; prioritize a comprehensive visit to close all outstanding HCC gaps before the coding deadline.

key_patterns.pattern: Member with low recapture rate and rising PMPM cost
key_patterns.meaning: Care costs are climbing while risk documentation lags, creating a financial exposure for the plan; assign a care manager to coordinate a gap-closure visit and review utilization drivers.

key_patterns.pattern: Member with large gap-to-potential-risk and no recent encounter on record
key_patterns.meaning: Significant uncaptured risk opportunity exists but the member is not engaging with the care system; trigger an outreach campaign or home visit to re-engage and document chronic conditions.

key_patterns.pattern: Member with declining YoY RAF and stable or increasing PMPM
key_patterns.meaning: Risk score erosion suggests conditions are being under-coded in the current year while costs remain high, signaling a documentation-to-cost misalignment; conduct a retrospective chart review and educate the assigned PCP on HCC specificity requirements.
